data: Which of the top two spectrograms presenting normalized frequency has a red line?

The question asks which of the top two spectrograms presenting normalized frequency has a red line. From the caption, we know that the top two spectrograms are (a) and (b). The figure shows two types of spectrograms: clean (a) and partially noise-corrupted (b). The red line is present only in the partially noise-corrupted spectrogram (b). Therefore, the answer is (b).
